overall_assessment: Personal data is removed reliably for MF. .anon_mf() cuts the trailing 'Emneansvarlig' contact block in all 24/26 offerings that have one (the other 2 have no contact block), including 'Etternavn, Fornavn' names, titles, e-mails and pages with several coordinators. The 'Eksamensdatoer' block is now removed as well, no names, e-mails, phones or exam dates are left, and no course content is lost. Remaining issues: (1) the handler's library-notice rule (#228) no longer matches because pages now read 'Tilgang til litteratur:' with a colon, so that boilerplate stays in 21/26 plans; (2) one plan keeps a semester-year ('Vårsemesteret 2026' becomes 'semesteret 2026'). Outside the packet, 'Semester: Høst og vår' becomes 'Semester:  og vår' in 2/26 offerings (MET5010, PPU1010), which has the same root cause as finding 2.

findings.evidence: Tilgang til litteratur: Noe av litteraturen er digital, annet finnes kun i papirutgave. Kompendier kan være tilgjengelige i Canvas.
findings.description: The MF-wide library-access notice ('Tilgang til litteratur: … søke om tilgang via ditt lokale folkebibliotek.') is still in course_plan, together with the lines around it ('Litteraturlisten for emnet finner du via lenken under.', 'MERK: Sjekk at litteraturlisten viser riktig semester (oppdatering kan ta litt tid).'). .anon_mf() is written to strip exactly this block (#228), so this is boilerplate the handler is meant to remove. It appears in 6/8 packet courses and 21/26 MF offerings. It is not personal data, but it adds the same ~600 characters of non-course text (Oria, Nasjonalbiblioteket, Canvas) to almost every plan. That inflates length measures and makes MF plans look alike to similarity measures. It also leaves the dangling 'Litteraturlisten for' after the generic rule removes 'vår 2026'.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R .anon_mf(): the rule '(?s)(?:Litteraturlisten for[^\n]*\s*)?Tilgang til litteratur\n.*?folkebibliotek\.' expects a newline directly after 'Tilgang til litteratur'. In the current harvest, all 21 raw texts have 'Tilgang til litteratur:' (with a colon) and none have the colon-less form, so the rule matches 0/26. A second line ('Litteraturlisten for emnet finner du via lenken under.') also sits between the 'Litteraturlisten for <semester>' label and the notice.
findings.suggested_fix: In .anon_mf(), replace the library rule with stringr::str_remove("(?s)(?:Litteraturlisten for[^\\n]*\\s*)*Tilgang til litteratur:?\\s*\\n.*?folkebibliotek\\.(?:\\s*MERK: Sjekk at litteraturlisten[^\\n]*)?"). Tested on all 26 MF offerings: it removes the notice, both 'Litteraturlisten for …' lines and the MERK line in all 21 plans that have them, leaves 0 behind and touches nothing else. Add the colon variant to the MF test in tests/testthat/test-anonymize.R.

findings.evidence: Avsluttende vurdering/eksamen [−Vårsemesteret−] semesteret 2026 har SAM2080L skriftlig skoleeksamen
findings.description: The raw sentence 'Vårsemesteret 2026 har SAM2080L skriftlig skoleeksamen …' became 'semesteret 2026 har SAM2080L …'. Two things go wrong. The semester-year stamp '2026' is left in, although the rubric requires semester labels with a year to be removed. And the season is cut out of the middle of the compound word, so the sentence starts with a lowercase fragment (text_corruption). This happens in 1/8 packet courses and 1/26 offerings.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R .anon_generic(). The lookbehind season rule '(?<=(?:semester|…|eksamen)[:\s]{0,3})(høst|vår|…)' matches because the heading 'Avsluttende vurdering/eksamen' plus the line break satisfy [:\s]{0,3}. The rule has no trailing \b, so it removes 'Vår' from inside 'Vårsemesteret'. The season+year rule needs the season directly before the year ('Vår 2026'), so the compound 'Vårsemesteret 2026' never loses its year. The same lookbehind rule also leaves 'Semester:  og vår' when the raw text is 'Semester: Høst og vår' (2/26 offerings, not in this packet).
findings.suggested_fix: In .anon_generic(), make two changes. (1) Before the lookbehind rule, add stringr::str_replace_all("(?i)\\b((?:høst|vår|haust)semester(?:et)?)\\s+\\d{4}\\b", "\\1"), which drops the year and keeps the season compound. (2) Change the lookbehind rule to "(?i)(?<=(?:semester|undervisning|oppstart|startsemester|eksamen)[: \\t]{0,3})(høst|vår|haust|autumn|spring|sommer|summer)\\b(?:[ \\t]+(?:og|and|/)[ \\t]+(?:høst|vår|haust|autumn|spring|sommer|summer)\\b)?". It then no longer reaches across a heading line break, no longer cuts inside a word, and also removes a coordinated second season. Tested on sample strings: 'Vårsemesteret 2026 har' becomes 'Vårsemesteret har', and 'Semester: Høst', 'Semester: Vår' and 'Semester: Høst og vår' all become 'Semester:'. Add these cases to tests/testthat/test-anonymize.R.
